messages:
maya-g: hey team, first day stuff — trying to kick off the CI for repo `redwood-examples` and GH Actions keeps failing with a permission error. unsure who to ping for org app installs :wave

sam: welcome maya! can you paste the exact error?

maya-g: sure — when I push my branch I get: 
```
Error: The request is not authorized to perform this action.
Resource not accessible by integration
```

zoe: that usually means the GitHub Actions app isn't installed on the repo/org or the app doesn't have write access. are you hitting a repo under `redwood-inc` org or a fork?

maya-g: it's under `redwood-inc/redwood-examples` (not a fork). I ran `gh auth status` and gh is logged in. tried re-running the workflow manually and it says the workflow can't be started by you.

sam: ok — two common causes: (1) the GitHub App (GitHub Actions or a custom org app) needs org admin consent; (2) the Buildkite GitHub app/webhook for the pipeline hasn't been granted access.

devops-bot: buildkite pipeline status: pipeline "examples-ci" has no recent webhook events. Last webhook delivery: 2026-03-20 14:22 UTC — 404 Not Found

zoe: @maya-g can you open Settings -> Actions -> General in the repo and check if "Allow local and third-party Actions" is restricted? if it's limited to organization apps, the org admin must install the app on this repo.

maya-g: I don't see that option (maybe I don't have settings perms). who is org admin I should ping?

sam: ping @zoe and @alex-s (org admin). alex usually handles installs. If you want a quick unblock, alex can either install the GitHub App for the repo or give your account `triage`/`write` for workflows. I'll paste the minimal steps: 

1) Org admin: visit https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inc/settings/apps
2) Find the GitHub App (e.g., "GitHub Actions" / "Redwood CI") and click "Install" -> choose the repo(s) or whole org.
3) Ensure the app has Workflow/Actions permissions (Read & Write) and repo webhooks are enabled.

zoe: also for Buildkite: make sure the Buildkite GitHub App is installed with repo access and the pipeline webhook secrets are set in Buildkite. otherwise the pipeline triggers will 404.

maya-g: thanks — alex pinged me in DMs and will install the app. small Q: once installed, do I need to push again?

sam: yes, push or re-run the workflow. after install it should accept your trigger. if it still fails, paste the GH Actions run id and we can look at logs.

maya-g: perfect — will do. appreciate the quick help! :pray:
